title: Digital receivable processing failed
description: Emitted as the digital_receivable_processed_failure event type when an asynchronous contract or negotiable instrument act operation cannot be applied to a digital receivable due to a business rule: applying a created or updated contract, renegotiating a contract, or creating a negotiable instrument act. One event is emitted per failed digital receivable, or one per contract on renegotiation failures. Consumers can use error_code and error_details to reconcile operations that were not applied.

digital_receivable_id.title: Digital receivable ID
digital_receivable_id.description: Client-provided identifier of the digital receivable, up to 20 characters, unique per organization. Absent on renegotiation failures, which are reported per contract.

contract_id.title: Contract ID
contract_id.description: UUID generated by Pismo for the contract whose application failed, or for the contract linked to the receivable on negotiable instrument act failures. Absent when no contract is involved.

contract_operation_id.title: Contract operation ID
contract_operation_id.description: Client-provided operation ID of the contract referenced by contract_id. Absent when contract_id is absent.

processed_instrument_act_id.title: Processed instrument act ID
processed_instrument_act_id.description: Client-provided ID of the negotiable instrument act that could not be applied to the digital receivable. Present only on negotiable instrument act failures.

lender_document_number.title: Lender document number
lender_document_number.description: CPF (11 digits) or CNPJ (14 digits) of the lender of the digital receivable. Absent when the receivable was not found and on renegotiation failures.

debtor_document_number.title: Debtor document number
debtor_document_number.description: CPF (11 digits) or CNPJ (14 digits) of the debtor of the digital receivable. Absent when the receivable was not found and on renegotiation failures.

face_value.title: Face value
face_value.description: Face value of the digital receivable in BRL with up to 5 decimal places. Absent when the receivable was not found and on renegotiation failures.

maturity_date.title: Maturity date
maturity_date.description: Maturity date of the digital receivable in yyyy-MM-dd format. Absent when the receivable was not found and on renegotiation failures.

error_code.title: Error code
error_code.description: Legacy business error code returned by the API explaining why the operation could not be applied to the digital receivable, for example 101053 (receivable not found), 108011 (contract not found), 114104 (receivable is BLOCKED and the act cannot be created) or 107023 (no receivables found for the renegotiated contract).

error_details.title: Error details
error_details.description: Structured error from the new error dictionary mapped from error_code. Absent when error_code has no mapping in the new dictionary.

code.title: Error code (new format)
code.description: Business error code from the new error dictionary in the 6-digit [MM][O][nnn] format (module, operation, sequence), for example 135001 for a receivable not found or 115001 for a contract not found.

description.title: Error description
description.description: Human-readable message for the new error code, not intended as a technical key.

feature_type.title: Feature type
feature_type.description: Functionality that triggered the failed operation, serialized from the FeatureType enum. CREATE_CONTRACT: a contract was created and applied. UPDATE_CONTRACT: a contract was updated, including payment updates, exclusions and renegotiations. DELETE_CONTRACT: a contract was terminated and unlinked. CREATE_INSTRUMENT_ACT: a negotiable instrument act was created and applied. UPDATE_INSTRUMENT_ACT: a negotiable instrument act was updated. DELETE_INSTRUMENT_ACT: a negotiable instrument act was terminated and unlinked.

operation_type.title: Operation type
operation_type.description: Specific operation within feature_type, serialized from the OperationType enum, for example CONTRACT_DIGITAL_RECEIVABLE_UNIT_CREATE or DIGITAL_RECEIVABLE_SUPPLEMENT_CREATE when a contract creates the receivable, UPDATE_CONTRACT_INCL, UPDATE_CONTRACT_ALTE or UPDATE_CONTRACT_EXCL for contract inclusions, changes and exclusions, CANCELLATION_ERROR, CLOSING, CLOSING_DJUD or CLOSING_RNGC for contract terminations, and CREATE_INSTRUMENT_ACT, UPDATE_INSTRUMENT_ACT_ALTE, UPDATE_INSTRUMENT_ACT_EXCL, CLOSING_ENEP, CLOSING_ENEM or CLOSING_ENES for negotiable instrument acts.
